methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The paper analyzed the strategy to improve the effectiveness of EnMS certification from the aspects of the enterprise, the certification body and the supervision department.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper addresses ISO 50001 energy management system (EnMS) certification effectiveness as an organisational/management strategy, discussed from the enterprise, certification body and supervision department perspectives. It does not present, propose, evaluate, or characterise any EnPI or EnB measurement model (no measured/normalised quantity, variables, functional form, or construction approach is identifiable). Energy-management maturity models appear only as cited prior work in the literature review, not as the paper's own contribution.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The strategy to improve energy management system certification effectiveness

stage1.notes: Qualitative strategy paper on EnMS certification effectiveness; presents no EnPI/EnB model. Maturity models cited (Antunes 2014; Jovanovic and Filipovic 2016) are prior work, not this paper's own model.
